links.outcome: Performance under random split versus resolution-defined acquisition-shift test on the same GI data
links.effect: Random-split AUROC 0.994 (95% CI 0.990-0.996) fell to 0.723 (95% CI 0.710-0.736) under resolution shift; intervals do not overlap.
links.quote: Random-split evaluation substantially overestimated performance relative to a resolution-defined acquisition-shift stress test, and entropy-based selective prediction improved reliability by identifying a high-confidence subset for automated prediction while deferring the remainder to human review.

links.outcome: Model performance under perturbed acquisition conditions (resolution shift)
links.effect: Under resolution shift, AUROC 0.723, sensitivity 0.417, specificity 0.874, accuracy 0.683.
links.quote: Under resolution shift on the same data, performance fell to AUROC 0.723 (95% CI 0.710-0.736; AUPRC 0.690; sensitivity 0.417; specificity 0.874); the two intervals do not overlap.

links.outcome: Accuracy among retained cases when the model abstains on uncertain cases and defers to humans
links.effect: Under shift, accuracy rose from 0.683 at full coverage to 0.852 (95% CI 0.835-0.871) at 25% coverage; balanced accuracy 0.646 to 0.798.
links.quote: Selective prediction improved reliability among retained cases: under resolution shift, accuracy rose from 0.683 at full coverage to 0.852 (95% CI 0.835-0.871) at 25% coverage (balanced accuracy 0.646 → 0.798).

links.outcome: Calibration (ECE) after target-domain recalibration under shift, and discrimination recovery
links.effect: ECE 0.172 to 0.036 with temperature scaling and 0.017 with isotonic regression; discrimination not recovered.
links.quote: Target-domain recalibration substantially restores calibration under shift (ECE 0.172 → 0.036 with temperature scaling; → 0.017 with isotonic regression) but does not recover discrimination; selective prediction is complementary, mitigating residual confident-wrong predictions.

links.outcome: Performance degradation from dataset/acquisition shift between development and test conditions
links.effect: AUROC dropped from 0.994 in-distribution to 0.723 under resolution shift.
links.quote: Under resolution shift on the same data, performance fell to AUROC 0.723 (95% CI 0.710-0.736; AUPRC 0.690; sensitivity 0.417; specificity 0.874); the two intervals do not overlap.

unlisted_practices: Entropy-based uncertainty-aware selective prediction with abstention
Cross-domain encoder transfer between endoscopic domains

screen.reason: The study evaluates an operational safeguard (entropy-based selective prediction / abstention and target-domain recalibration) under acquisition shift to identify high-confidence subsets versus deferring uncertain cases to clinicians.
